subject: Critical Thinking
title: Steelmanning: Making the Strongest Version of the Other Side
description: A micro-lesson that makes Steelmanning: Making the Strongest Version of the Other Side usable.

hook.text: Strawmanning attacks a weak version of the opposing argument.

buildup.text: To steelman: restate the opposing position so well that the opponent says 'Yes, that's exactly what I mean – maybe.

discovery.text: Daniel Dennett's rules: 1) Restate their view clearly. 2) List anything you agree with.

twist.text: Steelmanning isn't being nice – it's strategic.

climax.text: It also changes you: by genuinely understanding the best opposing view, you often refine your own position.

punchline.text: If you can't state the other side's case, you don't understand the issue.

quiz.question: What is steelmanning?
options: Building the strongest possible version of the opposing argument before responding
Strengthening your own argument with more evidence

details.summary: Steelmanning means rebuilding your opponent's argument in its strongest possible form before attacking it. This is the opposite of the straw man fallacy and leads to genuinely productive debate.
details.whyItMatters: Defeating a weak version of someone's argument proves nothing. Steelmanning ensures you engage the real challenge rather than an easy target.
takeaways: Steelmanning is the opposite of straw-manning
It forces you to deeply understand opposing views
Defeating a steelmanned argument is genuinely convincing

faq.question: How do you steelman an argument you strongly disagree with?
faq.answer: Temporarily set aside your position and ask what the strongest possible version of the opposing claim would look like. Add the best evidence and logic you can imagine supporting it, then respond to that.

faq.question: Why is steelmanning more persuasive than attacking weak arguments?
faq.answer: Audiences and opponents respect you more when you defeat the best version of a claim. It shows intellectual honesty and makes your rebuttal nearly impossible to dismiss.
